text:
maria: Heads-up: infra plans to soft-deprecate the old v1 auth pattern next week. We need small docs fixes (snippets, migration note, release blurb). Who can pick what?

sam: i'll own JS + Py snippets and a migration diff. what exactly changes?

maria: v1 used a top-level `api_key`. v2 requires `auth: { type: 'bearer', token: ... }` and server tokens should include `x-rw-service` header for intents. We'll emit a deprecation warning for 14 days then 401.

ashley: i opened a draft PR touching /guides/migration and SDK examples. left TODOs where old init is used. https://github.com/redwood-ai/docs/pull/4823

igor: added minimal examples for curl and Go in the thread (will push soon).

kevin: need to sync release notes and ensure eng enables the soft-deprecation window. also want a canary in eu-west.

docs-bot: Link check results: found 2 broken anchors; ashley pushed a tiny anchor fix commit.

maria: action items:
- sam: update snippets + add smoke test script (owner)
- igor: push Go + curl examples
- ashley: land PR, add 'migration: v1->v2 auth' label, ping legal for release blurb
- kevin: coordinate infra canary and email cadence

sam: plan to add a smoke test run in examples repo that demonstrates warning vs 401. example: `RW_KEY=old-key node examples/auth-check.js || true`

ashley: proposed timeline: docs patch today, release note tomorrow, enable soft-deprecation 2026-04-01, enforce 2026-04-15.

maria: sounds good. tag me in PRs for merge priority. :rocket:
